description: Town-centre parking occupancy, summer vs typical weekday (supporting evidence only)
notes: Report text: core CBD occupancy 'consistently more than 80%' on Wed 2 Dec 2015 (typical weekday) AND on Wed 30 Dec 2015 (peak summer); on 30 Dec the whole CBD incl. Flinders Pde was 'at or near capacity for much of the day' (2 Dec: outside the core parking was readily available). So the core was already above 80% on a typical day: this shows the summer peak widens the busy area, not a ratio. The '26-29%' figures sometimes quoted are not core CBD occupancy (the 26% on 30 Dec is a single overflow car park at Coles). No traffic factor is derived from this.
